Class SettingProvider<T>

java.lang.Object
de.eldoria.schematicbrush.brush.config.provider.SettingProvider<T>
Type Parameters:
T - type of provided class
Direct Known Subclasses:
ModifierProvider, SchematicSelectionProvider, SelectorProvider
public abstract class SettingProvider<T> extends Object
Base class for the provider classes.

See implementation to use them.

      public SettingProvider(String name, String localizedName, String description)

    • inputs

      public List<SettingInput> inputs(@Nullable T current)
      The inputs the dialog editor shows to enter the arguments of this setting.

      Defaults to one empty text input per argument. Override it to offer choices, toggles or numbers instead, and to start from the current value.

      Parameters:
      current - the current setting of the same type, which may come from another provider; null if none is set
      Returns:
      inputs in argument order
